Item.Description: Included in the tax base for both VAT and excise duty - unless included in the customs value - commission, transport and insurance costs already incurred to the first destination within the territory of the country. The first place of destination means the place mentioned in the consignment note or any other transport document on the basis of which the goods are imported.
The amount representing the value of the tax excise stamps paid by the importer to receive them, given in full PLN
The amount of the fuel fee and the import emission fee included in the VAT tax base

included in the taxable amount with excise duty in the case of importing a passenger car - unless they have been included in the customs value - commission, transport and insurance costs, and have already been incurred to the first destination within the territory of the country The first place of destination means the place mentioned in the transport document or other document on the basis of which the car is imported
value of goods exported under outward processing. This code should only be used in 6121B01, 6121B02, 6121B03, and 61211B1
Total value of correction which influenced the basis for determination of the statistical value when customs value of the goods is not determined (increases only statistical value)
Total value of correction which influenced the basis for determination of the statistical value when customs value of the goods is not determined (reduces only statistical value)
